title: 第十三章 、自以为是的蠢货，众人回归
slug: 末日求生欧皇女配在线摇人
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“想打就打，你比老三还要恶心，至少老三还能坦然面对自己的欲望，你是既要又要。”

端木棠梨不屑看着老六，一开始只以为这人是个莽撞的愣头青，后面事情结束后，他那一连套自残举动，倒是让端木棠梨对他刮目相看。

能屈能伸，是个大人物的好苗子。

现在嘛！

端木棠梨表示自己也有眼瞎看走眼的时候，这就是一个披着仗义持言莽撞汉子皮，实际上道貌岸然的伪君子，既要又要，还不如他其他兄弟坦诚。

“大小姐，我说的是实话，你实力是高，但也没有到无敌的地步，奉劝你赶紧将手里的道具分一分，否则别怪我不客气。”

如果可以，老六实际上不想跟端木棠梨对上。

不怕敌人实力高，就怕敌人实力强悍又有脑子。

“吓唬你家老祖宗不成，刚才也不知道谁，劝都劝不住，非要将自己打成猪头脸，跪在我家大小姐膝下，请求大小姐原谅自己罪过来着。”

现在却傲慢认为自己手里道具能秒杀大小姐，真是搞笑。

难怪小梨子说这人虚伪讨人厌，米樱昭雪现在对着人感官也十分不好。

“哼，你一个下贱的仆人知道什么，那是老子的战术。”

“将自己打成猪头脸，让别人没机会打你的战术吗？”

“欺人太甚，不给你一点颜色看看，你都不知道马王爷有几只眼。”

“哎呀，人家好怕怕，英雄饶命啊！人家真的是不知道马王爷有三只眼，你别对付人家，好不好，嘻嘻，真好玩，大小姐，你看看那人脸色青青紫紫，气的都要晕过去，气量真小。”

米樱昭雪三百六十度大旋转，站立之后，给老六比了一个中指向下挑衅手势。

气的老六眼睛更红，额头上皮肤裂开一条缝，缝里有鲜红色的嫩肉出现。

随着他表情越愤怒，额头上裂缝变得越大，直到中间裂缝出现了拇指大小的嫩肉组织。

众人惊骇发现那块拇指大小嫩肉里面慢慢挤出来一个血红色的眼睛，直勾勾看着在场所有人，浑身散发出恐怖煞气。

“尔等凡人颤抖吧！”

老六自以为睥睨众生看着众人，实际上除了他家兄两位弟，其他人都觉得这家伙脑子有问题。

Page (1/3)

"Fight me if you want. You are even more disgusting than the third child. At least the third child can face his desires calmly. You want both."

Duanmu Tangli looked at Lao Liu with disdain. At first, she thought this man was a reckless young man, but after the incident, his series of self-mutilation actions made Duanmu Tangli look at him with admiration.

Able to bend and stretch, he is a good candidate for a big shot.

Now!

Duanmu Tangli said that sometimes he was blind and misguided. He was a rash man who pretended to be just and upright, but in reality he was a sanctimonious hypocrite. He wanted both and was not as candid as his other brothers.

"Miss, I am telling the truth. Your strength is high, but you are not invincible. I advise you to quickly divide the items in your hand, otherwise don't blame me for being rude."

If possible, Lao Liu actually didn't want to confront Duanmu Tangli.

We are not afraid of the enemy being strong, but we are afraid that the enemy is strong and wise.

"It's not enough to scare your ancestors. I didn't know who it was just now, but I couldn't persuade you. I had to beat myself into a pig-headed face, kneel at the knees of my eldest lady, and beg her to forgive me for my sin."

Now he is so arrogant that he can kill the eldest lady instantly with the tools in his hand, which is really funny.

No wonder Xiaolizi said that this person is hypocritical and annoying, and Miying Zhaoxue also has very bad senses towards people now.

"Hmph, what do you, a lowly servant, know? That's my tactic."

"Is it a tactic to beat yourself up into a pig-headed face so that others have no chance to hit you?"

"It's too much to bully someone. If I don't give you some clues, you don't even know how many eyes Lord Ma has."

"Oh, I'm so scared. Hero, spare your life! I really don't know that Lord Ma has three eyes. Don't deal with me, okay? Hehe, it's so fun. Miss, look at that man's face. He's so angry that he's going to faint. He's so weak."

Mi Yingzhaoxue turned 360 degrees, stood up, and gave Lao Liu a middle finger downward provocative gesture.

The angry Lao Liu's eyes became even redder, and the skin on his forehead split into a crack, with bright red tender flesh appearing in the crack.

As his expression became angrier, the crack on his forehead became larger, until a tender fleshy tissue the size of a thumb appeared in the middle crack.

Everyone was horrified to find that a blood-red eye slowly squeezed out of the tender piece of thumb-sized meat, looking directly at everyone present, exuding a terrifying evil aura.

"You mortals, tremble!"

Lao Liu thought he was looking down on everyone, but in fact, except for his two brothers, everyone else thought there was something wrong with this guy's brain.
